content.short: Ninjalerts is an easy-to-use NFT trading tracker for Ethereum that sends push notifications for activity on followed contracts or wallets.
content.description: Ninjalerts is an easy-to-use NFT trading tracker focused on Ethereum. You can follow a curated set of contracts or wallets and receive activity alerts on your mobile devices and in Google Chrome. Developers can also use these notifications for trading workflows. Currently, Ninjalerts supports Ethereum only, but the team is exploring other blockchains, and the app is mobile-compatible on iOS and Android, making it the only mobile-compatible NFT analytics app with support for both platforms.
content.meta: Ninjalerts provides push notifications for Ethereum NFT activity. Discover Ninjalerts and other NFT Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
